about_the_game:
Open world meets classic survival horror gameplay in this atmospheric first-person adventure.
Explore, solve puzzles and discover the terrifying truth behind Veilmoore Isle.

content_descriptors.notes: contains some depictions of death, blood and violence with dark themes

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD RX 580 (6GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
